description: This file defines the interface and functions for integrating hiredis with libevent, including event handling, attachment, and cleanup routines.

classes.name: redisLibeventEvents
classes.description: Structure holding the context and event objects for libevent integration with hiredis.

methods.name: redisLibeventReadEvent
methods.description: Handles read events by calling redisAsyncHandleRead on the context.

methods.name: redisLibeventWriteEvent
methods.description: Handles write events by calling redisAsyncHandleWrite on the context.

methods.name: redisLibeventAddRead
methods.description: Adds the read event to the event loop.

methods.name: redisLibeventDelRead
methods.description: Removes the read event from the event loop.

methods.name: redisLibeventAddWrite
methods.description: Adds the write event to the event loop.

methods.name: redisLibeventDelWrite
methods.description: Removes the write event from the event loop.

methods.name: redisLibeventCleanup
methods.description: Cleans up and frees the event structure.

methods.name: redisLibeventAttach
methods.description: Attaches redisAsyncContext to a libevent event base, initializing event handlers.
